tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig gi gsal byed nyang ston grub pa'i gter ma bzhugs//

thugs rje chen po'i spyan 'byed lo rgyus ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pa pos lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas bton/ des khong rang gi spyan gsal bar byas/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ding ma pa'i spyan nyang stod du gsal bar byas pas zab par shes so// ser sna ma byed rgya cher spel gsungs so// 'di'i sgom thabs dngos gzhi ni/ rang thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis sngags chu spyan la byugs pa'i phyag rgya byas pa can/ g.yas 'og ma na dngul gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa g.yon 'og ma me long bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/ sngags 'di mi tshig gis bar ma chod par stong bzla'o// lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtsa bar sngags 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig zas ma zos pa'i gong du btab la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i srin lag gis sngags chu mig g.yon la byug /sngags ni 'di'o// tadya thā/ āom̐ hu ya hu ya/ hu du hu du/ ki li ki li/ tsakṣuḥmai tri shā tru na ye swā hā/ zab rgya rgya/ 'di'i sku nyams tshul la bzhengs dang bzhugs pa gnyis 'dug pas brtag par rigs shing*/ yang na sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus su blta'o/// /1$0000250 ༈ bla ma mchog la gus pas 'dud// 1$0000300sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum bya/ de nas stong par sbyang*/ de'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du yi ge hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis mig 'byed sngags chus mig la byug pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa/ g.yas 'og mas dngul dkar gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas dngul dkar gyi me long rab 'byams zhing khams gsal bar sku khrus gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la mngon par bzhengs pa'i sku la rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa/

dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ pañtsa li kā'i sham thabs can/ ri dwags kṛṣṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas kyi rigs bdag dang bcas pa'i thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las/ 'od zer sngags nus phyag rgya'i rtse la spros pa las/ rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad la sogs/ phyi nang bar 'grib/ sngo rib rtsa drwa mdzer ling thog /skam rlon tshag pa/ pags tshad mdzer lhog la sogs mig skyon mig nad thams cad sel ba'i nus stobs dang ldan par bsam/ de nas sngags bzla ba ni/ tadya thā/ āom̐ hu ya hu ya/ hu du hu du/ ki li ki li tsakṣuḥmai tri shā tru na ye swā hā/ de nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral sogs dang*/ de nas/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs brjod/ 'di yan chad dpe tshan 'di dang po'i gter byon dngos de yin pa 'dra/ 'di la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis snang yang 'og ma'i 'di zhal shes lag len yin pa 'dra/// / 1$0000250༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig 'byed pa'i gdams pa nyang gi gter ma de nyid kyi gsal byed skabs don gsum pa bzhugs/1$0000300 gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs rje chen pos rtag par 'gro kun la// gzigs mdzad yi dam lha la gus btud nas// de yi sgo nas mthong byed chu bur mig /rgyal ba'i spyan ltar gsal bar byed pa'i thabs// sngags la brten pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di// dang po gang nas byung ba'i lo rgyus ni// dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyang ston sgrub pa po// zhes pa mnga' bdag chen po nyang ral pa// mtshan dngos nyi ma'i 'od zer grags pa des// gnas ni lho brag mkhar chu'i gter nas bton// de nas khong rang dag gis nyams su bzhes// spyan nad byung gyur ma lus bsal bar byas// de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ding ma pa'i// spyan gnyis 'grib par gyur la nyang stod du// gdams pa bka' gtad bskur nas gsal bar byas// bsnyen pas sngags 'byed byin rlabs che bar grags// zab par shes so ser sna ma byed par// gdul bya rnams la rgya cher spel ces gsungs// de lta'i gdams pa shog dril nyang chen sras// 'gro ba'i mgon pos smra bo lcog po ru// ri bskor mdzad tshe gter shog phyag tu babs// nyams bzhes spyan gnyis gsal bar sku tshe bsgril// de lta ba nyid ji bzhin gter shog bu// grang so sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yis// lho brag gnas chen gtam shul ri bo la// bskor ba'i lam khar rlung gis khyer ba ltar// gdams pa'i yi ge 'khrul med sku mdun rnyed// gong gi gdams pa sgo gnyis rim brgyud du// gsan par ma ltos khyad par bka' babs bzhed// sku tshe mthar phyin nyid du spyan yang gsal// de la zab gter gsum ka'i bka' babs rje// mnga' ris rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan zhabs// sku tshe brgya phrag nyid du 'gro ba'i don// lhur mdzad nyin mtshan chos kyi sbyin par brtson// bgres rgud mi mnga' ye shes spyan ldan des// dgyes bzhin bdag la gnang ba da lta'i bar// rgya dbus byang gtsang kun du 'gro don byas// da ni rang yang nyams su len bde zhing*// rjes 'jug yongs la phan phyir rgyas par bkrol// dang po yig rnying ma nyams rtsa bar byas/

༈ gnyis pa 'di yi sgom thabs dngos gzhi ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / de skad skyabs sems sgom pa lan gsum bya/ swa bhā ba yi sngags kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rig hrīḥdakar po// skad cig yongs gyur thugs rje chen po nyid// shel gyi ri bo ltar gsal rnam dag sku /zhal gcig zla rgyas zhi 'dzum phyag bzhi pa// dri med padma dang ni zla ba'i dal// gdan la zhabs zung mnyam pa'i stabs bzhengs pa// phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis ni mig 'byed kyi// sngags chu spyan la byug pa'i phyag rgya can// thugs kar bcas shing g.yas kyi 'og ma yis// dngul gyi bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba// bsnams pas sdig sgrib dri ma kun 'khrud pa// g.yon gyi 'og mas me long bsnams pa la// rab 'byams zhing khams gsal bar sku khrus gsol// sna tshogs rin po che yi rgyan gyis brgyan// dar gyi sham thabs na bzas nyer bklubs pa// ri dwags lpags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab// gsung mchog snang ba mtha' yas dbu la brgyan// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med nyid du gyur// ngag 'don bzhin du sgom lugs lag len bstan// lo rgyus yid ches phan yon spro ba bskyed// sngon 'gro dge ba'i las 'bad yar ngo la// dben par mtshams bcad grib 'dzem dkar gsum brten// tho rangs nas brtsam sngags 'di mi tshig gis// bar ma chod par stong bzlas dmigs pa ni// sngags nus phyag rgya'i rtse las 'od zer 'phros// g.yas 'og bum pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis// g.yon pa'i me long ngos su khrus gsol bar// byed pa ji bzhin rang gzhan mkha' mnyam pa'i// sems can kun gyi bag chags las sdig sgrib// nad gdon grib las gyur pa'i sgrib byed kun// rlung gis sprin gtor dri ma 'khrud pa ltar//

rnam gsal dag dran brtan bya bsnyen sgrub ste// lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pa'i srin lag gi /rtsa bar sngags 'di nyi shu rtsa gcig ni// zas ma zos pa'i gong la bzlas byas pas// g.yon pa'i srin lag dag gi rtse mo yis// g.yas pa'i sngags chu mnye zhing rtse mo gtang*// mig g.yon phug nas phyir la byug cing phyi// de bzhin g.yon pas g.yas la byug cing phyi// rab rib grib sogs nad gdon kun phyis nas// mig gnyis rnam dag spyan sgo phye bar bsam// phyogs la gsal 'grib khyad par yod pa na// 'grib phyogs sngags btab phye tshul sngon la bya// de ltar las sbyor rgyun du 'bad byas te// sngags ni 'di ltar gces pa'i yig 'bru'i them/ tadya thā āom̐ hu ya hu ya brgyad// hu du hu du ki li ki li brgyad// tsakṣuḥmai tri shā tru na ye brgyad// brgyad tshan gsum mthar swā hā dang bcas pa'i// brgyad tshan dang po'i gsum dang bzhi pa dang*// de bzhin gsum pa'i lnga pa mthar swā hā// yig 'bru lnga la 'a btags gzhan thung ngu*// nyi shu rtsa drug 'khrul med zab mo 'o// tho rengs nam langs gong bzlas nyin dang mtshan// rang rang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dkyus la 'jug /ched du bsngags pa'i bsgrub bya dag yin na// skabs der yang ni ma ṇi'i dzap nyid la// gtsor bton bya 'o zab phyir bsnyen sgrub ni// dus kyi bsnyen pa zhag bdun nyi shu gcig /grangs bsnyen gong du nyams len skabs bshad bzhin// mtshan ma'i nges pa nyi shar sgron me sbar// sgo phyes g.yogs bsal mig ldan sbyin mthong thos// rab yin khrus byas gyen 'dzegs mtho yangs bgrod// dri can mdog nag zhwa gos lh+wam phud 'bring*// mun khung 'dam rdzab kha char bu yug bying*// grib sel sgrib sbyong rim gro spang dag 'bad// phan stobs dge dang mi dge brda dang rtags// mtshan ma dngos nyams rmi lam nges par 'byung*// gang shar rten 'brel legs pa'i thabs su bsgyur//

1$0000270༈ gsum pa 'di la 'bad dgos phan yon ni// dbang po'i dwangs ma mig las gces pa gzhan// ci zhig de phyir nad med gzhon nu nas// bsnyen sgrub sngon song mig skyon 'byung mi 'gyur// pha ma la sogs 'grib rigs sri las thar// mig nad 'gos pa'i rims dang 'tshe ba skyob// phyi nang bar 'grib ling thog rtsa khrag srin// tshag pa skam rlon rdzi ma'i nad gang la'ang*// sman rdzas dpyad dang mtshungs pa'i phan pa ster// rtsa shed che zhing gsal snang nyams su myong*// gso dpyad gzhung las spang bya'i gnad bshad pa// 'byed dus ma sleb yol sogs 'ga' zhig la'ang*// gdams pa 'di yi zab khyad ston pa ste// de phyir gnas skabs chu bur mig gsal bas// chos nyid mngon sum ngo mtshar ltad mo blta// mthar thug ye shes spyan ldan thob phyir du// lo rgyus nyams len phan yon don gsum du// gsal bar sdeb po sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin// shrī bkra shis stobs rgyal dbang po'i sdes// bzhi bcu rtsa bdun lon tshe 'byang gi yul// padma'i lcog sgar gnas su sbyar bkod 'dis// ji snyed 'gro la phan don byed gyur cig /maṅga laṃ//1$0000300 ༈ 'di'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ snang ba mtha' yas thugs rje chen po dang*// padma 'byung gnas nyang chen sgrub pa por// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// 'gro ba'i mgon po shākya bzang po dang*// rig 'dzin legs ldan chos rgyal dbang po'i sder// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// 'di yan chos rgyal dbang po'i sde'i gsung*/ de'i kha skong du/ rigs kun khyab bdag ngag gi dbang po dang*// mkhas btsun grub brnyes bkra shis rnam rgyal mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// rdo rje 'chang dngos dkon mchog dpal 'byor zhabs// rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtsug rgyan padma'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol// bstan pa'i gsal byed blo bzang don grub zhabs// gdams pa'i bka' babs rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so gsal byed dngos grub stsol//

ces pa 'di'ang bdag rig pa 'dzin pa bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis/ mig la phan phyir gdams pa 'di'i bsnyen mtshams zhag bdun byas te grol ba'i dga' ston du/ gdams pa'i dpe 'di lcags 'brug rang lo nga gsum hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga la grub pa'i bsti gnas o rgyan gling du bris pa'i dge bas ma gyur sems can thams cad ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthar gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥs manta tsakṣur bi sho dha ni swā hā/
